code: import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径图片/链接转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签（可选） """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): # 处理可能的懒加载属性 src = img.get('src') if not src.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'data:')): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, src) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): href = a.get('href') if not href.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'javascript:', 'mailto:', '#')): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, href) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """ 解析日期字符串，支持多种格式 返回 YYYY-MM-DD 格式 """ if not date_str: return None # 清理空白字符 date_str = date_str.strip() # 尝试匹配常见格式 patterns = [ r'(\d{4})[-/年](\d{1,2})[-/月](\d{1,2})', # 2025-12-01, 2025/12/01, 2025年12月01日 ] for pattern in patterns: match = re.search(pattern, date_str) if match: y, m, d = match.groups() return f"{y}-{int(m):02d}-{int(d):02d}" return None def save_results(articles, output_path): """保存结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"[Success] 已保存 {len(articles)} 条新闻到 {output_path}") except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 保存文件失败: {e}") # ================= 爬虫逻辑 ================= def extract_detail_content(page, url): """提取详情页内容""" try: page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) # 等待内容区域加载，尝试几个常见的选择器 content_selectors = [ ".zw_main", # 常见正文区 ".TRS_Editor", # 常见编辑器类名 "#content", # 通用ID ".article-content", # 通用类名 ".zw_main3", # 变体 ".allDetailBox" # 变体 ] content_html = "" for selector in content_selectors: if page.locator(selector).count() > 0: content_html = page.locator(selector).first.inner_html() break # 如果没找到特定容器，尝试提取 body 文本作为兜底（不推荐，但比空好） if not content_html: print(f"[Warn] 未找到明确的正文容器，尝试提取 body 内容: {url}") # 这里可以根据实际情况决定是否提取 body 或留空 # content_html = page.locator("body").inner_html() # 提取来源/作者信息 source = "" author = "" # 尝试查找来源信息 info_selectors = [".zw_info", ".info", ".article-info"] for sel in info_selectors: if page.locator(sel).count() > 0: info_text = page.locator(sel).first.inner_text() # 简单的解析逻辑，实际可能需要正则 if "来源" in info_text: parts = info_text.split() for part in parts: if "来源" in part: source = part.replace("来源：", "").replace("来源:", "") break return { "content": clean_html_content(content_html, url), "source": source, "author": author } except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 提取详情页失败 {url}: {e}") return {"content": "", "source": "", "author": ""} def crawl_news(): """主爬取函数""" articles = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() current_url = TARGET_URL page_num = 1 stop_crawling = False while not stop_crawling: print(f"正在爬取第 {page_num} 页: {current_url}") try: page.goto(current_url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=30000) # 等待列表加载 try: page.wait_for_selector(".rightListContent", timeout=10000) except: print("[Warn] 未找到列表元素，可能已无数据或页面结构变化") break # 获取所有列表项 items = page.locator(".rightListContent").all() if not items: print("[Info] 当前页无数据") break page_valid_items = [] for item in items: try: # 提取日期 date_el = item.locator(".rightListTime") if date_el.count() == 0: continue date_text = date_el.inner_text().strip() pub_date = parse_date(date_text) if not pub_date: continue # 日期过滤逻辑 if pub_date > END_DATE: # 日期太新，跳过 continue if pub_date < START_DATE: # 日期太旧，停止整个爬取 print(f"[Info] 遇到旧数据 ({pub_date} < {START_DATE})，停止爬取") stop_crawling = True break # 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.locator(".rightListImport.unlock a") if link_el.count() == 0: continue title = link_el.get_attribute("title") or link_el.inner_text().strip() href = link_el.get_attribute("href") full_url = urljoin(current_url, href) page_valid_items.append({ "title": title, "date": pub_date, "sourceUrl": full_url, "source": "中国债券信息网" # 默认来源 }) except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 解析列表项出错: {e}") continue # 处理当前页符合条件的条目 print(f"当前页提取到 {len(page_valid_items)} 条符合条件的数据") for item in page_valid_items: print(f"正在抓取详情: {item['title']}") detail = extract_detail_content(page, item['sourceUrl']) item.update(detail) articles.append(item) # 礼貌性延时 time.sleep(1) if stop_crawling: break # 翻页逻辑 # 检查是否有下一页 # 这里的翻页逻辑基于静态页面规律：index.html -> index_1.html -> index_2.html # 或者检查页面上的翻页按钮 # 尝试查找下一页按钮或链接 # 页面结构中可能有 但可能是空的 # 我们直接构造URL尝试，因为这是最稳健的静态分页方式 next_page_url = "" if page_num == 1: next_page_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, "index_1.html") else: next_page_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, f"index_{page_num}.html") # 验证下一页是否存在（通过简单的请求或页面元素判断） # 这里简单处理：如果当前页有数据且没触发停止，就尝试去下一页 # 但为了防止404，我们可以检查页面底部的分页条 # 检查分页条是否存在下一页的链接 # 这里的逻辑是：如果当前页数据都符合日期要求（没有触发break），说明可能还有更早的数据在下一页 # 但如果当前页已经包含了比 END_DATE 小的数据，且没有触发 < START_DATE，说明还在范围内 page_num += 1 current_url = next_page_url # 简单的防死循环：如果连续翻页太多次（例如超过50页），强制停止 if page_num > 50: print("[Info] 达到最大翻页限制，停止") break except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 页面处理出错: {e}") break browser.close() return articles def main(): print("=== 开始爬取中国债券信息网新闻 ===") print(f"目标URL: {TARGET_URL}") print(f"日期范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) articles = crawl_news() if not articles: print("[Warn] 未找到符合条件的新闻") return output_file = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"chinabond_news_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.json") save_results(articles, output_file) print("=== 爬取完成 ===") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
